'''Vertseth Automata''' was a company that made [[Techno-service droid/Legends|techno-service droids]]. It was located on the planet [[Vertseth/Legends|Vertseth]]. [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]], a techo-service droid in the employ of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] was built there.
